title: New benzimidazole based hybrids: Synthesis, molecular modeling study and anticancer evaluation as TopoII inhibitors.
authors: Nawareg, Nareman A; Mostafa, Amany S; El-Messery, Shahenda M; Nasr, Magda N A
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成苯并咪唑类TopoII抑制剂并做抗癌活性评估，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，仅提及降低转录因子DNA结合活性，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Three series of new benzimidazole hybrids were designed and synthesized as promising human TopoII inhibitors. They were characterized by different spectroscopic techniques ((1)H, (13)C NMR, ESI-MS and IR). All hybrids (6-23) were screened for their in vitro antiproliferative activity against five human cancer cell lines namely; HepG-2, MCF-7, PC-3, HCT-116 and Hela. Compound 21 showed the most potent anticancer activity against all cancer cell lines, with IC(50) range of 2.82 to 12.59 microM, while proving safe towards normal cells WI-38 (IC(50) = 31.89 microM) compared to the reference drug doxorubicin (IC(50) = 6.72 microM). The most active candidates 13, 20, 21, 22 and 23 were further assessed for their human TopoII inhibition. The best of which, compounds 13 and 20 showed IC(50) of 6.72 and 8.18 microM respectively compared to staurosporine (IC(50) = 4.64 microM). Further mechanistic studies for compound 13 showed cell cycle arrest at S-phase by 51.29 % and a significant increase in the total apoptosis by 62.5 folds. Furthermore, apoptosis study proved that it induced apoptosis by decreasing both IAP and Bcl-2, activating caspases 3, 8 and 9, and increasing accumulation of ROS in HepG-2 cells. Besides, it decreased transcription factors' binding activity to DNA. Comparative molecular docking study was performed between the most potent TopoII inhibitors 13 and 20, and the least potent one 23 to relate the binding pattern with TopoII catalytic active site to the biological activity, where all results came in agreement with the biological results. Additional molecular modeling studies including surface mapping and contact preferences were performed to emphasize the importance of hydrophobicity. Physicochemical calculations were assessed where compounds 13 and 20 represented very promising orally active drug candidates.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了三个系列的新型苯并咪唑杂合体，作为有前景的人TopoII抑制剂。通过不同的光谱技术（(1)H、 (13)C NMR、 ESI-MS 和 IR）对其进行了表征。对所有杂合体（6-23）进行了体外抗增殖活性筛选，针对五种人类癌细胞系，即 HepG-2、 MCF-7、 PC-3、 HCT-116 和 Hela。化合物21对所有癌细胞系显示出最强的抗癌活性，IC(50) 范围为 2.82 至 12.59 微摩尔，同时对正常细胞 WI-38（IC(50) = 31.89 微摩尔）表现出安全性，与参考药物多柔比星（IC(50) = 6.72 微摩尔）相比。对最具活性的候选物13、 20、 21、 22 和 23 进一步评估了其对人TopoII的抑制作用。其中，化合物13和20表现最佳，IC(50) 分别为 6.72 和 8.18 微摩尔，与星形孢菌素（IC(50) = 4.64 微摩尔）相比。对化合物13的进一步机制研究表明，其导致细胞周期阻滞在S期，比例为51.29%，并使总细胞凋亡显著增加62.5倍。此外，凋亡研究证明，它通过降低IAP和Bcl-2、激活caspases 3、 8 和 9，以及增加HepG-2细胞中ROS的积累来诱导凋亡。此外，它还降低了转录因子与DNA的结合活性。对最强TopoII抑制剂13和20以及最弱抑制剂23进行了比较性分子对接研究，以关联与TopoII催化活性位点的结合模式与生物活性，所有结果均与生物结果一致。进行了额外的分子建模研究，包括表面映射和接触偏好，以强调疏水性的重要性。进行了物理化学计算评估，其中化合物13和20代表了非常有前景的口服活性药物候选物。
